device: compact peristaltic dosing pump head for a benchtop water-quality analyzer
failure: peristaltic pump tubing ruptures within days because the rotor occlusion force concentrates on one fixed tube line and the tubing wall fatigues at the pinch point, causing dosing drift and analyzer sample-starvation alarms
